candidates.title: Calgary Opera replaces performer who unfurled Palestinian flag during Tosca bow
candidates.description: On Friday, the bass singer Gabriel Sanchez-Ortega held up the flag at the end of Giacomo Puccini's drama about love and betrayal during political upheaval in Napoleonic Rome.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: N.L. man sentenced to 7 years in prison for shooting snowmobiler in the head
candidates.description: A Port au Port West man has been sentenced to seven years in prison for shooting a snowmobiler in the head almost two years ago.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Former journalist Pamela Wallin resigns from Senate
candidates.description: Sen. Pamela Wallin has unexpectedly resigned from the upper chamber with a few remaining years before her slated retirement date.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Former Winnipeg mayor Sam Katz violated public trust, ex-CAO lacked moral compass, police HQ inquiry says
candidates.description: Former Winnipeg mayor Sam Katz “violated the public trust” and former city chief administrative officer Phil Sheegl displayed “a complete lack of a moral compass” by engaging in "blatant" conflicts of interest involving the owner of the construction company awarded the contract to build the city’s police headquarters, the provincial public inquiry into the scandal-plagued project concluded.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Quebec's reserves of maple syrup almost depleted, says new report
candidates.description: The head of Quebec's maple syrup producers' association says the province's strategic syrup reserve has run dry amid high demand for the product.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Harness driver dies after multi-horse collision at Osoyoos, B.C., raceway
candidates.description: Desert Park Raceway says 52-year-old harness driver Scott Knight died after a multi-horse collision at the track in Osoyoos, B.C., on Sunday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Unifor Stellantis workers in Ontario vote 97% in favour of strike mandate with talks still stalled
candidates.description: The workers with global automaker Stellantis are stationed at factories in Windsor, Toronto and the idled Brampton assembly plant.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Cybersecurity firm hired by Hamilton says director arrested by FBI didn't handle city's ransomware response
candidates.description: In the wake of the FBI's arrest of a former cybersecurity executive on another issue, the firm that was tasked with helping Hamilton recover from a 2024 cyberattack says he had no involvement in the work it did for the city.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Where do B.C.'s parties stand on the future of AI data centres?
candidates.description: AI data centres have become a hot-button political issue the world over, and in British Columbia it's no different.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: It's voting day in Yellowknife. Here's what you should know
candidates.description: Today is voting day for the Yellowknife municipal elections, as well as the trustee elections for two school boards in the city.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Inconsistent guidelines for AI use in N.S. classrooms fuel calls for provincewide policy
candidates.description: Nova Scotia does not have a provincewide policy explicitly stating how AI should be used in the classroom. The provincial government says it’s up to regional centres for education to make their own rules about the technology. Parents and educators are calling for more consistency, and say guardrails are needed.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Son of Oro-Medonte, Ont., mayoral candidate 'critically injured' in CFB Wainwright fire
candidates.description: Cathy Keane, who is running for mayor in Oro-Medonte, Ont., says she's taking time away from campaigning to be with her son, who was "critically injured" after a large fire broke out over the weekend at the Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Pile of dead Canada geese discovered near Garson, Man.
candidates.description: Manitoba Conservation says it's investigating after a man operating a grader discovered a pile of dead Canada geese in a ditch just north of Garson, Man., on Friday morning.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 'The country is behind you,’ says N.L. veteran in wake of tragedy at CFB Wainwright
candidates.description: Like many other Canadians with loved ones in the military, Jordan Dowber says he started his Sunday with a heavy heart after he heard about the tragic fire that took place at a Canadian Armed Forces base in Wainwright, Alta., on Saturday.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Andrew Davies delivers fastest-ever marathon debut by Canadian in Toronto Waterfront race
candidates.description: Andrew Davies was the talk Sunday morning at the Toronto Waterfront Marathon, delivering the fastest-ever debut by a Canadian over 42.2 kilometres at two hours eight minutes 48 seconds for ninth overall in the men's race at the event that doubles as the national marathon championships.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Former Marineland beluga whale dies at California theme park
candidates.description: A California aquarium says a beluga rescued from Marineland in Ontario has died, adding to the number of deaths of animals relocated over the summer from the now-closed Canadian facility.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Save-On-Foods loyalty program members had personal information accessed in cybersecurity breach
candidates.description: A major Canadian supermarket chain has notified customers in its loyalty program that their personal information was accessed during a cybersecurity breach. The chain says it discovered the activity on one of its servers, which was "quickly contained" before launching an investigation.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Police issue curfew in Paris after weekend rioting over cost of living, school conditions
candidates.description: Paris police issued an overnight curfew on Monday in two areas of the French capital in efforts to prevent further violence, after a weekend marred by France's worst rioting in years that targeted city halls, other public buildings and thousands of businesses across the country.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: UN food program funding cuts force group to slash aid to Gazans already struggling to eat
candidates.description: The United Nations World Food Programme (WFP) says ‌funding shortages are forcing major cuts to its aid program in Gaza, leaving about 500,000 people without monthly food support in a territory where two-thirds of the population struggle to get enough to eat.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: 4 soldiers from El Salvador missing in Haiti after attack by gangs
candidates.description: Gangs in Haiti opened fire on an armoured vehicle over the weekend, leaving four soldiers from El Salvador unaccounted for in the first major attack since an international gang suppression force began operations in the violence-wracked Caribbean country.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Houthi attack on Yemeni government forces kills 53: officials
candidates.description: Fifty-three people were killed and 200 were injured in an attack on Monday by Iran-aligned Houthi rebels on a government security forces training camp in ‌Yemen's coastal Shabwa province, according to the local authority.
candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: NATO's race against time: Senior commander warns alliance must adapt faster to deter Russia

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Russian oil exports by Arctic route jump amid world freight crisis, data shows

candidates.title: Israel arrests 10 people after West Bank settler attacks on diplomats, journalist

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Australian MP Helen Haines in critical condition after deliberate vehicle attack, prime minister says

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Doing the dishes and riding the subway? Why the royals keep trying to look relatable

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: St. Petersburg oil facilities ablaze as Ukraine launches more than 1,000 drones at Russia

candidates.author: CBC News

candidates.title: Pope Leo returns to Vatican after lung cancer surgery
